0022600100.text: The Utah Jazz host the New Orleans Pelicans in a regular-season game, and neither team has a 2026-27 game on record yet. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out. The Jazz lost all three meetings with New Orleans in the 2025-26 season, most recently 156-137 in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
